title: Clifton Cottage
description:
Welcome to your Nashville oasis! Bright, spacious, and fully remodeled in 2023. With brand new appliances, a large fenced backyard, and pet-friendly policy, it's perfect for a comfortable and convenient extended stay. Located near major hospitals and less than 10 minutes from Broadway and Germantown. Book now and experience Nashville's charm! Perfect for traveling nurses, students, and corporate travelers.

The space
Three bedroom, two bathroom bright and spacious home with dining area, seated island kitchen, smart TVs in each room and high speed internet. In unit laundry free of use for tenants. 

A large back yard with a deck, BBQ grill, and outdoor furniture. Three car driveway and ample free street parking at the property. Outdoor spaces maintained by an owner-paid landscaper.

Guest access
Full home and yard is yours to use - you're renting the whole property, no space restrictions.
